propositions.question: Was Al Udeid struck?
inference_basis: Independent satellite/BDA evidence documents strike damage.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: None short of evidence that the imagery was mislocated or predated the attack.

propositions.question: Was the AN/FPS-132 early-warning radar physically hit and damaged?
inference_basis: Planet imagery and later photographs identify physical damage to the radar, including burned components.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Contrary geolocation or pre-strike imagery demonstrating the damage predated the attack.

propositions.question: Was the AN/FPS-132 materially degraded or temporarily knocked out?
inference_basis: Burned electronics/wiring are strong circumstantial evidence of functional degradation.
credible_alternatives: Partial or redundant operation may have continued.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Technical logs showing uninterrupted full-capability operation.

propositions.question: Was the AN/FPS-132 permanently destroyed beyond repair?
inference_basis: Public imagery cannot establish repair economics or eventual restoration.
credible_alternatives: Damage was terminal and full replacement is required.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Return-to-service reporting, repair contract, replacement procurement, or authoritative terminal-loss assessment.

propositions.question: Was the Al Udeid CAOC rendered inoperable?
inference_basis: Multiple Iranian missile hits were reported to have rendered the CAOC inoperable.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Credible post-strike operational logs showing the Qatar CAOC remained functioning.

propositions.question: Was the whole Al Udeid Air Base rendered inoperable?
inference_basis: Documented CAOC loss does not equal whole-base mission kill.
The air campaign continued through distributed C2 already shifted to Shaw.
credible_alternatives: Other localized base functions could have been degraded.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: Evidence of simultaneous cessation of flightline, logistics and all major base functions for a material period.

propositions.question: Did Iranian attacks damage the installation?
inference_basis: Did Iranian attacks damage the installation?
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: New independent physical evidence, primary records, or later operational behavior materially inconsistent with the present inference.

propositions.question: Were every claimed fighter hangar/fuel-storage loss and exact equipment kill independently proven?
inference_basis: Facility damage is independently verified, but the record does not prove every claimed fighter-hangar, fuel-storage and exact equipment loss.
credible_alternatives: Some claimed subcomponents may have been damaged without being independently resolved.
evidence_that_would_change_assessment: New independent physical evidence, primary records, or later operational behavior materially inconsistent with the present inference.
